title: GAAMA: Graph Augmented Associative Memory for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2603.27910v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents that talk with users across many sessions need long-term memory to stay coherent and personalized. Existing approaches use either flat retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that ignores how memories connect, or entity-centric knowledge graphs. Entity-centric graphs split each message into separate triples, which loses its context, and in conversations the speakers become hubs linked to almost every message, so propagation through them tells retrieval little. We present GAAMA, a graph-augmented associative memory that organizes conversations around topics. It keeps verbatim episodes, uses an LLM to distill them into atomic facts and topic concepts, and then synthesizes higher-order reflections. translated_title: GAAMA：面向智能体的图增强联想记忆
translated_abstract: 跨越多个会话与用户对话的AI智能体需要长期记忆来保持连贯性与个性化。现有方法要么采用扁平的检索增强生成（RAG），忽略了记忆之间的关联方式，要么采用以实体为中心的知识图谱。以实体为中心的图谱会将每条消息拆分为相互独立的三元组，从而丢失了上下文；而且在对话场景中，说话者会成为与几乎所有消息相连的枢纽节点，因此经由这些节点进行传播对检索帮助甚微。我们提出GAAMA，一种图增强的联想记忆，它围绕主题来组织对话。GAAMA保留逐字记录的情节片段，利用LLM将其提炼为原子事实和主题概念，进而合成更高阶的反思。这四种节点类型通过五种结构化的边相互连接，主题概念提供了横跨各处的路径，从而避免形成巨型枢纽。检索将最近邻相似度搜索与个性化PageRank相结合（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出GAAMA，一种围绕主题组织对话的图增强联想记忆框架，通过情节、原子事实、主题概念与高阶反思四类节点及五种结构边避免巨型枢纽问题，并结合最近邻搜索与个性化PageRank提升AI智能体长期记忆的检索效果。
en_tdlr: GAAMA is a topic-organized graph-augmented associative memory for AI agents that links episodes, atomic facts, topic concepts, and higher-order reflections via structural edges to avoid mega-hub issues, combining nearest-neighbor search with Personalized PageRank for effective long-term memory retrieval.
